hero.title: Welcome to AppBox
hero.description: Hi, I am Ankit Raikwar and this is my AppBox This website is a collection of my work, featuring live demos and detailed descriptions of each project.I created this site to make it easy for you to explore what I’ve built. All projects are deployed on VPS and ready for you to try out. Thank you for visiting—I hope you enjoy browsing through my creations as much as I enjoyed making them!

project1.title: Nursery Marketplace
project1.description: A MERN stack e-commerce platform for nursery products with authentication, product management, and role-based access control

project2.title: CodeBot
project2.description: A MERN stack code editor with real-time collaboration and syntax highlighting

project3.title: MERN Blog
project3.description: A MERN stack blog with authentication, post management, and comment functionality

project4.title: Currency Converter
project4.description: A MERN stack currency converter with real-time exchange rate updates
